					<span class="et_overlay"></span>
				</a>
				</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_gallery_pagination"></div></div><style></style><style></style>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="desc_hebergement" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_3 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3 et_pb_row_fullwidth et_hover_enabled et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_5 et_hover_enabled  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div id="desc_suite" class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Sea-view Suites</h2>
<p>At Mazava Loha Resort, our suites, small independent villas nestled on the dunes, offer a fantastic view of the Emerald Sea, as well as all the comforts of high-end accommodation.</p>
<h3>Description :</h3>
<ul>
<li>60 m² suite (double/triple).</li>
<li>Each suite has a terrace with a fantastic view of the Emerald Sea, 100m² in size, with a seating area, sunbed, and table space.</li>
<li>Sea view: Terrace, bed, living room, bathroom.</li>
<li>No opposite neighbors.</li>
<li>Queen size bed (210/200)</li>
<li>Indoor lounge, desk</li>
<li>Private bathroom and toilet.</li>
<li>Hot water, fan, refrigerator with cold drinks.</li>
<li>Interior/exterior lighting, 220v outlets in each bungalow.</li>
</ul></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_6 et_hover_enabled  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div id="desc_suite" class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Bungalows Forest</h2>
<p>Our six wooden bungalows, nestled in the vegetation, true havens of peace with a zen atmosphere, offer a total change of scenery under the gaze of lemurs.</p>
<h3>Description :</h3>
<ul>
<li>Each bungalow is nestled in a forest clearing and enjoys total privacy.</li>
<li>Double bungalows of 24 m² with terrace.</li>
<li>Family bungalows of 40 m² (2 bedrooms) with terrace.</li>
<li>Private bathroom and toilet.</li>
<li>Hot water.</li>
<li>Interior/exterior lighting and outlets.</li>
<li>Cold drinks in the bungalows.</li>
</ul></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_4 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_4">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_7  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div id="desc_suite" class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Restaurant/bar.</h2>
<p>Our restaurant/bar, offering a panoramic view of the Emerald Sea, provides fine and varied cuisine with ultra-fresh products (as much as possible from daily fishing and markets).</p>
<p>Breakfast is served buffet-style, with numerous choices of starters, main courses, and desserts for lunch and dinner.</p>
<p>The bar, a place for sharing the day&#8217;s adventures, offers a wide selection of drinks (alcoholic or non-alcoholic).</p>
<p>Explore Mazava Loha Resort for a unique experience with family, as a couple, or with your loved one, including relaxing massages in the heart of the preserved nature of Diego Suarez, Madagascar.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_6">
